title: Crossroads of Continents: Automated Artifact Extraction for Cultural Adaptation with Large Multimodal Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating geographic region classification accuracy from images, extracting implicit and stereotypical cultural artifacts using open-vocabulary object detection with tf-idf scoring, and analyzing country-specific color and population-count associations in generated images.
Grouping and comparing the model's regional classification accuracy across different region-specific normalized income quartiles using the DOLLAR STREET dataset.
